# Data Loading & Cleaning


```{r load-data}

FILE_PATH = "data/full_data.csv"
raw <- read_tsv(FILE_PATH, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-16LE"),  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Inspect
# glimpse(raw)
```

```{r clean-data}
df <- raw %>%
  filter(FINISHED == 1) %>%
  filter(TIME_SUM >= 300) %>%
  # drop admin / test entries
  filter(MODE != "admin", prolific_id != "test", FINISHED == 1, STATUS == "complete") %>%
  mutate(
    age             = as.numeric(age),
    gender          = factor(gender, levels = 1:2, labels = c("male", "female")),
    model_condition = factor(model_condition,
                             levels = 1:3,
                             labels = c("Unprompted", "Sycophantic", "Contrarian")),
    topic  = factor(topic)
  )

cat("N after exclusions:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

```{r attitude-scoring}
# Helper: row-wise mean ignoring NA
row_mean <- function(df, cols) {
  rowMeans(df[, cols], na.rm = TRUE)
}


topics <- c("space", "quota", "taxes", "animals", "speech")

# build composite pre-post opinion and confidence measures & experience composites via means
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Pre Opinion
    opinion_pre = case_when(
      topic == "space"   ~ space_02,
      topic == "quota"   ~ pre_quota,
      topic == "taxes"   ~ pre_taxes,
      topic == "animals" ~ pre_animals,
      topic == "speech"  ~ pre_speech
    ),
    # Post-opinion
    opinion_post = case_when(
      topic == "space"   ~ post_space_04,
      topic == "quota"   ~ post_quota,
      topic == "taxes"   ~ post_taxes,
      topic == "animals" ~ post_animals,
      topic == "speech"  ~ post_speech
    ),
    opinion_change = opinion_post - opinion_pre,
    confidence_change = post_confidence - pre_confidence,
    # Scale composites
    competence  = row_mean(., c("competence_01", "competence_02", "competence_03")),
    trust       = row_mean(., c("trust_01",       "trust_02",       "trust_03")),
    satisfaction = row_mean(., paste0("satisfaction_0", 1:5)),
    sycophancy  = row_mean(., c("sycophancy_01",  "sycophancy_02")),
    credibility = row_mean(., c("credibility_01", "credibility_02", "credibility_03")),
    continuance = row_mean(., c("continuance_01", "continuance_02"))
  )
```

```{r}
# Data Prep

df$condition <- relevel(factor(df$model_condition), ref = "Unprompted")
df$extremityPre <-  abs(4 - as.numeric(df$opinion_pre))
df$extremityPost  <-  abs(4 - as.numeric(df$opinion_post))


# OLS

fit_ols <- function(dat, formula) {
  m <- lm(formula, data = dat)
  coef_tab <- summary(m)$coefficients
  ci_tab <- confint(m)
  combined <- cbind(coef_tab, ci_tab)
  em <- emmeans(m, ~ condition)
  list(model = m, coef_table = combined, emmeans = em)
}

res <- fit_ols(df, extremityPost ~ condition + extremityPre)

res


# Plot

coef_df <- as.data.frame(res$coef_table) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
  filter(grepl("^condition", term)) |>
  mutate(
    term_label = recode(term,
      "conditionSycophantic"    = "Sycophantic",
      "conditionContrarian" = "Contrarian"
    ),
    term_label = factor(term_label, levels = c("Sycophantic", "Contrarian"))
  )

ext_plot <- ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = Estimate, y = term_label, color = term_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = `2.5 %`, xmax = `97.5 %`), height = 0.15) +
  labs(x = "Change in Opinion Extremity (0-3 Scale)", y = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sycophantic" = "#82B88A",
                                 "Contrarian" = "#D4807A")) +
  theme_apa() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"), 
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
  )
ext_plot
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "opinion_extremity.pdf"), plot = ext_plot, width=8, height=5)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "opinion_extremity.png"), plot = ext_plot, width=8, height=5)
```






# Confidence Extremity 


```{r}



# Data Prep

df$condition <- relevel(factor(df$model_condition), ref = "Unprompted")
df$extremityConfPre <-  abs(4 - as.numeric(df$pre_confidence))
df$extremityConfPost  <-  abs(4 - as.numeric(df$post_confidence))


# OLS

fit_ols <- function(dat, formula) {
  m <- lm(formula, data = dat)
  coef_tab <- summary(m)$coefficients
  ci_tab <- confint(m)
  combined <- cbind(coef_tab, ci_tab)
  em <- emmeans(m, ~ condition)
  list(model = m, coef_table = combined, emmeans = em)
}

res_conf <- fit_ols(df, extremityConfPost ~ condition + extremityConfPre)

res_conf


# Plot

coef_conf_df <- as.data.frame(res_conf$coef_table) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") |>
  filter(grepl("^condition", term)) |>
  mutate(
    term_label = recode(term,
      "conditionSycophantic"    = "Sycophantic",
      "conditionContrarian" = "Contrarian"
    ),
    term_label = factor(term_label, levels = c("Sycophantic", "Contrarian"))
  )

ext_plot <- ggplot(coef_conf_df, aes(x = Estimate, y = term_label, color = term_label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = `2.5 %`, xmax = `97.5 %`), height = 0.15) +
  labs(x = "Change in Opinion Extremity (0-3 Scale)", y = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Sycophantic" = "#82B88A",
                                 "Contrarian" = "#D4807A")) +
  theme_apa() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"), 
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    legend.position = "none",
  )
ext_plot
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "confidence_extremity.pdf"), plot = ext_plot, width=8, height=5)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "confidence_extremity.png"), plot = ext_plot, width=8, height=5)
```
